## Dataset Background: Data Source

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
forestry.all <- read_csv("./01_EDA/data/Urban_Forestry_Street_Trees.csv",
                         col_select = c(-36, -37, -40))
n_rows <- nrow(forestry.all)
n_cols <- ncol(forestry.all)
dim(forestry.all)
```

- **Dataset:** DC Urban Forestry Street Trees (`Urban_Forestry_Street_Trees.csv`)
- **Source:** Open Data DC / DC Urban Forestry Division
- **Unit of observation:** one street tree (identified by `OBJECTID` / `GLOBALID`)
- **Size:** 222830 x 47

## Dataset Variables

- **Contents:**
  - Tree attributes: species (`SCI_NM`, `GENUS_NAME`), size (`DBH`), `CONDITION`
  - Site attributes: tree box size (`TBOX_L`, `TBOX_W`), `WARD`, `CURB`, `SIDEWALK`, `WIRES`
  - Lidar-derived crown measurements (2020, in feet): `MBG_WIDTH`, `MBG_LENGTH`, `MAX_MEAN`, `MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT`
  - Administrative fields: `CREATED_DATE`, `LAST_EDITED_DATE`, `RETIREDDT`
  - Location: `X`, `Y` coordinates

## Dataset Background: Variables of Interest

- **Possible response:** `CONDITION` (categorical)
  - Collapse into "good" vs. "bad" for logistic regression
  - Estimate the probability a tree is in good condition
- **Numeric predictors:** `DBH`, `TBOX_L`, `TBOX_W`, `MBG_WIDTH`, `MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT`
- **Categorical predictors:** `GENUS_NAME`, `WARD`, `WIRES`, `CURB`, `SIDEWALK`

## Exploratory Data Analysis: Condition Obstacles

```{r}
#| include: false
livetrees <- forestry.all |> filter(RETIREDDT != "NA")
nrow(livetrees)
```

- **Retired vs. living trees** (`RETIREDDT`)

  - Splits the data into two populations
  - Only 5,452 trees have a retirement date

## Missing/Invalid Data

- Several columns have \> 100,000 `NA`s *(list them from the NA table)*

- Missingness for the model variables checked as % missing (`CONDITION`, predictors)

- **Invalid values**

  - Negative `DBH` values present
  - Extreme `DBH` values \> 100 inches
  - Extreme `TBOX_L` outlier (one record flagged for review)

- **Cleaning decision:** `DBH` restricted to 0 to 100 for plots, [**decide about modeling**]{.underline}.

```{r}
#| include: false
dist_vars <- forestry.all |>
  filter(DBH > 0, DBH < 100) |>
  select(DBH, MBG_WIDTH, MBG_LENGTH, MAX_MEAN, MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT, TBOX_L) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis (pt 1): Numeric Variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(dist_vars, aes(value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis (pt 2): Numeric Variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
print(
  ggplot(dist_vars, aes(y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal()
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot(1:10)
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis (pt 1): Relationships and Spatial View

- **Correlation among numeric predictors**

  - `MBG_WIDTH` and `MBG_LENGTH` correlation: \[value from `cor(forestry.pairs)`\]
  - Collinearity check on `DBH`, `TBOX_L`, `TBOX_W`, `MBG_WIDTH`, `MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT`
  - `MBG_WIDTH` is the main concern; no other pair above \~0.6

- **Spatial distribution:** `X` vs. `Y` scatter shows tree locations across the city
